8.4.1.13 Nm_PncBitVectorTxIndication
[SWS_Nm_91008] Definition of callback function Nm_PncBitVectorTxIndication
Upstream requirements: RS_Nm_02544, SRS_ModeMgm_09250
⌈
Service Name
Nm_PncBitVectorTxIndication
Syntax
void Nm_PncBitVectorTxIndication (
NetworkHandleType NetworkHandle,
uint8* PncBitVectorPtr
)
Service ID [hex]
0x27
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant for the same NetworkHandle, reentrant otherwise
Parameters (in)
NetworkHandle
Identification of the NM-channel
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
PncBitVectorPtr
Pointer to the bit vector with all PNC bits set to "1" of internal
requested PNCs
Return value
None
Description
Function called by <Bus>Nms to request the aggregated internal PNC requests for
transmission within the Nm message.
Available via
Nm.h
⌋
